profiles.title: Tracked design review
profiles.description: A normal explicitly tracked design-review workflow that evolves across turns and eventually makes completion claims, while retaining conditional coverage for practical boundary situations that may occur during the lifecycle.

cases.condition: The user asks to reset or reinitialize after an error while valid Mandala state exists.
cases.rationale: A long-running review can hit an error that prompts a reset request; valid state must then be preserved rather than reinitialized.

cases.condition: The user separately and explicitly authorizes a destructive clean.
cases.rationale: Deliberately discarding a review's tracking state is an occasional lifecycle event, not part of normal review progress.
Updating the tracked review from conversational context across turns is the normal workflow of an explicitly tracked design review.
The review eventually reports completion, so completion claims grounded in a zero-gap observation are intrinsic to it.
Review state evolves across turns, so a later completion claim must reflect the current state rather than an earlier zero-gap observation.

cases.condition: The target parent is already at child capacity.
cases.rationale: A growing review can reach a parent's child capacity; this boundary only applies when it does.

cases.condition: The target branch has exactly one legal child slot remaining.
cases.rationale: Filling the final legal child slot only arises when the review grows to that boundary.

cases.condition: The Mandala tree has no legal structural slot remaining.
cases.rationale: A completely full tree only arises in unusually large reviews.

cases.condition: The request is generic gap analysis without explicit Mandala authorization.
cases.rationale: Within a review conversation a user may ask for plain gap analysis that does not authorize Mandala tracking.

cases.condition: The user explicitly asks not to use Mandala.
cases.rationale: A user may opt out of Mandala for a specific request even while a tracked review exists.

cases.condition: The existing Mandala state is invalid or corrupt.
cases.rationale: Corrupt state is an abnormal condition that the review may encounter but does not normally produce.
The review depends on the Mandala CLI; its absence is an environment condition, not normal workflow.

profiles.title: Capacity-constrained expansion
profiles.description: An active tracking workflow where structural capacity boundaries and safe restructuring behavior are the principal concern.

cases.rationale: Reset and reinitialization requests are outside this capacity-focused profile view.
Explicit destructive clean is outside this capacity-focused profile view.
Capacity-constrained expansion happens inside an actively tracked workflow updated across turns.

cases.condition: A completion claim is requested after the tracked expansion work.
cases.rationale: Completion claims are relevant only when the expansion work is followed by a request to declare completion.

cases.condition: State may have changed between an earlier zero-gap observation and a later completion claim.
cases.rationale: Stale completion evidence matters only when expansion work changes state after a zero-gap observation.
Handling a parent already at child capacity is a principal concern of this profile.
Using the final legal child slot without overflow is a principal concern of this profile.
Handling a tree with no legal structural slot remaining is a principal concern of this profile.
Activation boundaries for generic gap analysis are outside this already-tracked capacity profile view.
Explicit non-use requests are outside this already-tracked capacity profile view.
Corrupt-state handling is outside this capacity-focused profile view.
Expansion depends on the Mandala CLI; its absence is an environment condition, not normal workflow.

profiles.title: Reset and recovery
profiles.description: A workflow centered on safe reset, explicit destructive authorization, valid-state preservation, and corrupt-state handling.

cases.rationale: Responding to a reset/reinitialize request while valid state exists is intrinsic to reset and recovery work.
Acting on a separate, explicit destructive clean authorization is intrinsic to reset and recovery work.
Contextual tracking updates are outside this reset/recovery profile view.
Completion claims are outside this reset/recovery profile view.
Completion claims after state changes are outside this reset/recovery profile view.
Structural capacity boundaries are outside this reset/recovery profile view.
Structural capacity boundaries are outside this reset/recovery profile view.
Structural capacity boundaries are outside this reset/recovery profile view.
Activation boundaries for generic gap analysis are outside this reset/recovery profile view.
Explicit non-use requests are outside this reset/recovery profile view.
Handling invalid or corrupt existing state is intrinsic to recovery work.

cases.condition: The Mandala CLI is unavailable when reset/recovery work is requested.
cases.rationale: Reset and recovery depend on the Mandala CLI; its absence is an environment condition, not normal workflow.
